frontmatter.title: Wave 3 - Tapestry: Surface as fills, Shape as height, the 248 fields as presets

description:
Kiln's Tapestry Shape emits signed per-pixel height fields with the bevel profile already authored in (smooth/linear/chamfer/step plus width) - a colour return is rejected outright - so it is exactly the height source the lighting stage wants. Kiln's Tapestry Surface emits seamless full-colour material; two of its three generators (steel, steel_clean) are measurably shape-independent and become fill generators, but plasma is NOT a fill - given a blank field it renders alpha 0 everywhere, its alpha IS its silhouette, so it is an emissive shape-coupled treatment. Port natively rather than exporting files, because an exported file cannot respond to a dial in real time and cannot animate. Three things must be added to make them fills: a time input (they have none), a palette-quantise step so output stays pixel art, and a shape-local-vs-world coordinate switch (the patterns are tile-anchored, so a moving sprite will appear to swim without it). 248 published height fields already exist - 245 at 256 square, three at 128 - but they are unnormalised float32 in the range -1.648 to +2.206, so shipping them as presets needs a per-field normalise or a height-scale dial. Note a Tapestry tool ALREADY EXISTS in Laubrary (Runtime/Tapestry, Editor/Tapestry) with a layer stack, blend modes, a tiled preview and PNG export - it keeps its job as the place surfaces are authored and browsed, and its blend modes are worth taking.

The authoritative design is the "Shaper - the design" tab of this group's planning document (also at D:\UNITY\Laubrary Dev\.agenthq\workspace\T-0098\SHAPER_THE_DESIGN.md). Read it before starting. Background: the three earlier reports are tabs of the PyrePlus group's planning document, and a condensed digest of them (incl. every withdrawn claim and every known live bug) is at D:\UNITY\Laubrary Dev\.agenthq\workspace\T-0098\P1-digest.md.

todos.text: Confirm the port contract against the live Shaper code: which Kiln pieces become fills, which become a height source, which is refused as neither
Port the toroidal canvas primitives (tapsurface/canvas.py + tapshape/canvas.py) to C#, verified tile-for-tile against the Python originals
Add the palette-quantise stage - the one of the three named additions that genuinely does not exist yet
Settle the time input and the shape-local-vs-world coordinate switch for procedural fills (both may already exist generically - verify, do not re-add)
Add an authored-height-field source to the height stage, so a Tapestry Shape field can drive bevel and lighting
Import all 248 published height fields as an in-repo preset library, with the normalise / height-scale decision made and measured
Port a real Tapestry Surface generator natively as a Shaper fill, checked against its Kiln port-verification contract dump
Rule on plasma explicitly - it is not a fill - and record where it goes instead
Adversarial verification pass: measure every claim, render a contact sheet, write the spec
